exceptions.alternatives: Narrowing the peer range to exclude TypeScript 7 would drop a version this package supports (ADR 0069).
exceptions.remediation: None; re-check when the next TypeScript 7 release changes publishers.
exceptions.ruleBroken: A dependency published by a new author should be reviewed before it is trusted.

exceptions.whyPreferable: The publisher is the TypeScript team's own release account set, so the alert reflects a first release of a new package name, not a change of control.
exceptions.residualRisk: Low; the package is not installed by this repository and is not shipped in its tarball.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The maintainers listed on npm for the TypeScript 7 binaries change.

exceptions.constraint: TypeScript 7 ships no programmatic API, so the build-time scanner needs a TypeScript 6 compiler. The compiler is shipped whole and unmodified because `bundleDependencies` bundles a package as published (ADR 0069).

exceptions.revisitWhen: TypeScript 7.1 ships a stable programmatic API and the scanner can use it, or the bundled compiler is dropped.
